third-party tender offer subject to Rule 14d-1.
Check the following box if the filing is a final amendment reporting the results of the tender offer. [ ]
This Schedule TO relates to the offer by UR Merger Sub VII Corporation to purchase all outstanding shares of H&E Equipment Services, Inc. at a price per Share of $92.00 net to the holder in cash, without interest, upon the terms and conditions in the Offer to Purchase and Letter of Transmittal.

documents.description: Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated January 13, 2025.

attachment_texts.text: The offer is to purchase all outstanding shares of H&E Equipment Services, Inc. for $92.00 per share in cash. The offer is subject to a minimum tender condition and other conditions, including regulatory clearances.
